condition: If you write datetimes with to_json's default epoch-ms format and read them back with read_json without setting date_unit, read_json has to guess the unit, so some dates (e.g. 1970-02-01 or 2300-01-01) come back as the wrong datetime.
workaround: Pass date_unit="ms" to read_json, set date_format="iso" on both sides, or convert afterwards with pd.to_datetime(col, unit="ms").
